test_cases.name: allof_composition
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /employees with allOf composed schema
Assert response contains fields from both PersonBase (firstName, lastName, email) and EmploymentDetails (department, position, startDate)
Assert status code is 201
Use proper optional chaining for response assertions

test_cases.name: oneof_notification
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /notifications with oneOf schema
Use one valid notification type (email, sms, or push)
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains the notification id and type

test_cases.name: array_of_objects_invoice
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /invoices with nested lineItems array of objects
Include at least one line item with description, quantity, unitPrice, and tax
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains lineItems array with proper structure
Assert response totalAmount is a number

test_cases.name: enum_query_params
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /reports with all-enum query parameters
Use valid enum values for type, format, and period parameters
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains report data

test_cases.name: header_params
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /tenants/config with required header parameters
Include X-API-Version, X-Tenant-ID, and Accept-Language headers
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains tenant configuration

test_cases.name: swagger_v2_format
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /pets endpoint from Swagger 2.0 spec
Use PetService.createPet method
Assert status code is 201 or 200
Assert response contains pet id and name
